name: es-irpf-deductions-cataluna
description: Calculate Cataluña regional credits for ordinary Spanish resident IRPF in 2026, for a taxpayer whose community of residence under LIRPF art. 72 is Cataluña. Covers regional credits; rural move, home investment and rent from 2026; July 2026 additions and conditional commencement. Each row gives the credit's amount, cap, income gate, sharing rule and article, with incompatibilities and any carry-forward the law allows. Use for deducciones autonómicas Cataluña, regional IRPF credits, alquiler, nacimiento, family, housing and gift relief in Cataluña. Load es-irpf-deductions first for the residence test, the deduction ledger, the state and regional order of credits, the attributable-tax worksheet, national credits, deadlines and penalties, and es-income-tax for the bases and scales. Split unchanged from es-irpf-deductions on 6 November 2026.
